description: SEO Audit Agent - audit a single page or bounded whole-site crawl from a URL. Deterministic checks in code, subjective checks via a config-swappable LLM (LiteLLM), schema-validated JSON output. Python 3.11+, CLI only, static HTML only.

userStories.title: Project scaffold and configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a configured Python project so that settings (model, crawl limits) live in config, not code.
acceptanceCriteria: pyproject.toml declares dependencies: httpx, lxml or beautifulsoup4, litellm, pydantic, pyyaml, typer or argparse, pytest
config.yaml contains model, temperature, and crawl limits (max_pages=50, max_depth=3, total_time_budget, request_timeout)
Environment variables override config.yaml values
.env.example lists API key variables and .env is in .gitignore
Config loads into a validated pydantic model; invalid config exits with a clear error message
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Output schema
userStories.description: As a consumer of the report, I want a defined JSON schema so that results are machine-readable.
acceptanceCriteria: Pydantic models exist for AuditReport, CrawlSummary, PageResult, Finding
Finding has fields: id, category, severity (critical|high|medium|low|info), source (code|model), evidence, recommendation, confidence
JSON Schema is exported to schema/audit-report.schema.json
A test validates a sample report against the exported schema
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Page fetcher
userStories.description: As the agent, I want to fetch a page with sane limits so that one bad URL cannot hang the run.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetch uses a clear User-Agent, request timeout, and max response size
Result records final URL, status code, redirect chain, response time, content type
Non-HTML content, timeouts, and connection errors are returned as results, not raised exceptions
Mocked-HTTP tests cover success, redirect, 404, timeout, non-HTML
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Page fact extraction
userStories.description: As the agent, I want structured facts extracted from HTML so that code checks and the model work from clean data.
acceptanceCriteria: Extracts title, meta description, headings with levels, canonical, robots meta, hreflang, viewport, Open Graph and Twitter tags
Extracts JSON-LD blocks (raw text plus parse success flag), images with alt, internal and external links, visible text
Visible text is truncated to a configurable character cap
Fixture-HTML tests cover each extracted field
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Crawler core with depth, page and time bounds
userStories.description: As a user, I want site mode to stop at defined limits so that cost and runtime are predictable.
acceptanceCriteria: Breadth-first crawl from the start URL using the fetcher and link extraction
Enforces max_pages, max_depth, and total_time_budget from config
Stays on the same host; subdomains included only if configured
Concurrency is capped by config
CrawlSummary records pages crawled, pages skipped, and which limit was hit
Tests with mocked site cover each limit being hit
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Crawler politeness, URL normalization and sitemap seeding
userStories.description: As a site owner, I want the crawler to behave politely and avoid duplicate URLs so that audits do not hammer or loop on my site.
acceptanceCriteria: robots.txt disallow rules are respected and blocked URLs are recorded as skipped
Crawl-delay is honored
URLs are normalized and deduped: fragments removed, trailing slashes, tracking params (utm_*, gclid, fbclid)
URLs from sitemap.xml are used as seeds when present
Tests cover robots blocking, crawl-delay, normalization cases, sitemap seeding
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Deterministic page-level checks
userStories.description: As a user, I want rule-based per-page checks run in code so that results are fast, free, and reproducible.
acceptanceCriteria: Checks implemented: missing/short/long title, missing/short/long meta description, H1 count, heading hierarchy skips, canonical missing or off-host, noindex present, missing viewport
Checks implemented: images missing alt, non-HTTPS, redirect chains longer than 1 hop, slow response, invalid JSON-LD, missing Open Graph tags
Every finding has source 'code', a severity, evidence, and a recommendation
Checks are registered in a check registry so new checks can be added without modifying the agent loop
One test per check using fixture pages with known issues, plus a clean-page test with zero findings
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Deterministic site-level checks
userStories.description: As a site owner, I want cross-page checks so that I find systemic issues like duplicate titles and broken links.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects duplicate titles and duplicate meta descriptions across crawled pages
Detects broken internal links (4xx/5xx targets among crawled or checked URLs)
Validates robots.txt presence and sitemap.xml presence and parseability
Findings have source 'code' with evidence listing affected URLs
Tests with multi-page fixtures cover each check
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Model-swappable LLM layer
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a single model interface so that changing providers needs only config.
acceptanceCriteria: All model calls go through one llm.complete() wrapper using LiteLLM
Model name is read only from config, env, or CLI override (e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5, openai/gpt-4o)
Wrapper requests JSON output, validates it against a pydantic model, and retries once on malformed output
Token usage is accumulated per run and exposed for the report
Tests with a fake model cover valid response, malformed-then-valid, and persistent failure
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Model-judged page checks
userStories.description: As a user, I want subjective assessments (title/description quality, content quality, search intent) so that I get insight rules cannot give.
acceptanceCriteria: Per-page prompt receives extracted facts and truncated text, never raw HTML
Model findings must include an evidence quote; findings whose quote is not found in the page text are dropped and the drop count is recorded
Model findings have source 'model' and a confidence value
On model failure, code findings are kept and an error entry is added to the report
Tests with a fake model cover valid findings, unverifiable evidence dropped, and model failure
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Site-level synthesis
userStories.description: As a site owner, I want a summary of cross-page patterns and top priorities so that I know what to fix first.
acceptanceCriteria: Model input is aggregated findings (counts per check plus example URLs), not full page text
Output populates site_summary with a prioritized list of top actions
Runs only in site mode; skipped in page mode
Model failure leaves site_summary empty with an error entry, without aborting the report
Tests with a fake model pass
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Audit orchestrator and CLI
userStories.description: As a user, I want a command to run an audit so that I can use the agent from the terminal.
acceptanceCriteria: Command: seo-audit <url> --mode page|site [--config PATH] [--model NAME] [--max-pages N] [--out FILE] [--format json|md]
Page mode audits only the given URL; site mode runs the crawler, page checks, site checks, model checks, and synthesis
--model overrides the configured model without code changes
Progress is printed to stderr; report goes to stdout or --out
Exit code is non-zero on invalid input or total failure
JSON output validates against schema/audit-report.schema.json and includes token usage
End-to-end test against a mocked site with a fake model passes
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Markdown report renderer
userStories.description: As a practitioner, I want a readable report so that I can share findings.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders summary, crawl limits hit, and findings grouped by severity then by page
Each finding is labeled as code- or model-derived
--format md uses the renderer
Snapshot test passes
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: README setup and usage docs
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want clear setup docs so that I can install, run, and switch models quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: README.md covers prerequisites, install, env/API key setup, page and site run examples, and how to switch the model via config and --model
README lists known limitations (no JavaScript rendering, static HTML only)
Every command shown in README was executed successfully (or --help verified) during this story
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: DESIGN.md design decisions
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want the design rationale written down so that I can judge the trade-offs.
acceptanceCriteria: DESIGN.md lists which checks run in code and which use the model, with the reason and pros/cons for the split
DESIGN.md explains how the crawl is bounded (pages, depth, time, robots, concurrency, normalization) and the trade-offs
DESIGN.md explains the output structure, the source/confidence fields, and the evidence-verification step
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: EVALUATION.md evaluation proposal
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want a rigorous evaluation proposal so that agent quality can be measured.
acceptanceCriteria: EVALUATION.md covers code-check fixtures with precision/recall per check
EVALUATION.md covers a labeled page set for model checks with human-agreement measurement, and LLM-as-judge calibrated against human scores

EVALUATION.md covers comparison to a reference tool (e.g. Lighthouse SEO or Screaming Frog), robustness cases (broken sites, robots-blocked, JS-heavy), and multi-model comparison on score, cost, latency, and variance
EVALUATION.md defines CI regression thresholds and success metrics
Typecheck passes
